question: The microorganisms which convert the dead plants and animals to humus are known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**decomposers.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decomposers** are microorganisms that break down dead organic matter, such as dead plants and animals, into simpler substances like humus.
 
• **Humus is a dark, organic material that is rich in nutrients and helps to improve soil fertility.**
 
• Decomposers play an important role in nutrient cycling, as they release nutrients from dead organic matter back into the soil, where they can be taken up by plants.
 
• Examples of decomposers include **bacteria, fungi,** and some types of insects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Producers are organisms that produce their own food through photosynthesis, such as plants and algae.**
 
• Autotrophs are organisms that can produce their own food, either through photosynthesis (like producers) or through other means, such as chemosynthesis.
 
• **Herbivores are animals that eat plants.**
